verdict.rationale: Codegen has a CLI, Python SDK, and REST API explicitly documented to trigger and manage agent runs, including a stated use case of triggering agents from CI/CD pipelines on build failure (codegen-docs-18), plus programmatic run creation/monitoring (codegen-docs-15, codegen-docs-16, codegen-docs-27). However there's no explicit evidence of headless/non-interactive flag support, exit-code semantics for pipeline gating, or shell-script examples showing invocation without the TUI/interactive elements. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI flags, exit-code/status conventions for CI gating, concrete shell-script or pipeline YAML examples, independent hands-on confirmation of CI usage.
